  │ ⟦Overview~~~~⟧                                                           │  
  │  ⟦Overview: repository status and the “Needs you” inbox (items awaiting  │  
  │  review, doctor warnings). Enter on a row opens the screen that handles  │  
  │  it.~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧          │  
  │  r                 ⟦Refresh the repository status~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧           │  
  │                    ⟦Check the environment (doctor)~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧          │  
  │                                                                          │  
  │ ⟦Global~~~⟧                                                              │  
  │  q                 ⟦Quit Bint~~~~⟧                                       │  
  │  ?                 ⟦Show the full help~~~~~~~~⟧                          │  
  │  :                 ⟦Open the command palette (search every               │  
  │                    action)~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧                           │  
  │  ctrl+f            ⟦Find anywhere: knowledge (incl. deprecated), tasks   │  
  │                    (incl. done), runs, eval                              │  
  │                    candidates~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧        │  
  │  L                 ⟦Switch interface language (vi ⇄ en)~~~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧   │  
  │  !                 ⟦Read the current notice in full plus the last 50     │  
  │                    notices from every                                    │  
  └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────⟦1–18/383 ↕~~⟧─┘
